notes.title: Creepy Tale: Snow Child voice recording
notes.notes:
We are happy to show you a piece from the voice recording of Creepy Tale: Snow Child.

Game will have Full professional voice acting in both Russian and English.

Actors:
Blizzy: Lina Ivanova.
Modest: Valery Storozhik.
Spirit of the Forest: Alexander Novikov.
Adele: Nina Malkina.

notes.title: Meet the Characters of Creepy Tale: Snow Child
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

We're excited to introduce the few characters of Creepy Tale: Snow Child.

But be careful.
They're just as excited to meet you.

Add the game to your wishlist... And become a part of our fairy tale.
